scope.objective: Reorganize academy repositories and autonomous execution around evidence-qualified canonical modules, stable identities, environment-specific native harnesses and accountable Work ownership, preserving existing owners and completed work.
successCriteria: Measured scoped host, container, source, worktree and runtime capabilities have explicit source pins and unknowns.
Repository/module canonical ownership, dependency rules and consumer migration are reviewable and preserve historical references.
Identity continuity, Work/Task DAG, single-tab accountability, shared-resource serialization and review gates are explicit.
A separately approved independent Astra/xhigh review guides staged implementation and meaningful verification.
Implementation, source verification, integration, native activation and teacher/user acceptance remain distinct.
inScope: Typed English architecture, canonical local Work records and approval-first independent review design.
After architecture approval and review disposition, staged source implementation using existing maintained owners.
outOfScope: Publication, PR, merge, deployment, native activation, real student writes, prints or sends under the retained hold.
Common contract, permission or unrelated Work changes without separate owner/user approval.
Credential inspection, private student original ingestion into architecture, source retirement or native loop replacement.
Taking over research/Ontology/Wiki semantics or unrelated runtime lifecycle.

acceptedDirection.firstProductOutcome: Teacher-reviewed state management, preparation and existing native execution handoff across seven internal workflows.
acceptedDirection.currentPhase: source-only survey and architecture; no review dispatch yet

topologyRules.containment: Host contains container; repositories contain source modules; book edition contains units. These are distinct trees.
topologyRules.ownership: One canonical maintained implementation per qualified capability; build location does not transfer semantic/data/native ownership.
topologyRules.semanticRelations: Prerequisite/relatedness and pedagogical cycles do not become execution dependencies or universal DAGs.
topologyRules.execution: Task milestone DAG separate from recurring lesson/clinic cycles and source provenance/supersession graphs.

dataPlanes.sourceEvidence: Owner-held immutable source observations with observed/event/retrieved clocks and explicit coverage.
dataPlanes.teacherDecisions: Scoped corrective/assessment decisions preserve the referenced occurrence and prior evidence.
dataPlanes.derivedCurrentState: Reproducible projection under qualified source revisions and decision rules, with unknown/conflict/partial/stale retained.
dataPlanes.preparedOperations: Exact student/date/activity/field/effect intent with native qualification and authoritative readback kept separate.
dataPlanes.privateStorage: Existing private owners; PostgreSQL is retained as the previously selected target where applicable. Synthetic SQLite remains a bounded offline consumer, not the production choice. No database migration in this phase.

currentStateDesign.joinRule: Use exact source namespace plus qualified crosswalk; unmatched records remain visible.
currentStateDesign.reductionRule: A later applicable scoped teacher correction supersedes the claim it actually corrects; newer unrelated timestamps do not erase other stages.
currentStateDesign.homeworkRule: Assignment/cancellation/replacement/actual completion are distinct; unassigned catalog rows and unknown states are not overdue work.
currentStateDesign.materialRule: Assessment original, attempt, generated paper, printed membership, distribution and teacher final judgment remain distinct.
currentStateDesign.implementationApproach: Extend existing domain/port/application structures with small owner-qualified contracts. Use revisioned observations and deterministic projections; do not introduce a universal event platform.

migrationStrategy: Qualify preserved Work results and unresolved effects before creating competing writers.
Select exact canonical per-capability implementations and freeze public contracts under existing owners.
Build source-backed projection/query slice and verify synthetic adversarial cases.
Route one workflow at a time through the common application contract; compare equivalent exposure and results.
Retain old compatibility paths until actual consumers are switched and equivalence is observed.
Remove duplicate maintained logic only with exact owner-reviewed replacement; preserve originals and history.
performanceCriteria: Measure equivalent record/observation coverage before comparing calls, bytes or latency.
Bound actual transport envelopes and refusal paths; preserve exact continuation and all requested facets/overlays.
Profile source loading and query plans before choosing indexes, caching or parallel fetches.
Invalidate derived state by exact source/decision revision; stale caches cannot resurrect cancelled assignments.
